newsitem.title: USA: U.S. wheat export inspections hit low.
newsitem.headline: U.S. wheat export inspections hit low.

text.p: The U.S. Agriculture Department Monday said U.S. wheat export inspections in the week ended December 26 were the lowest since at least 1982, when USDA began keeping computerized records of the data.
The department reported earlier wheat export inspections totalled 4.488 million bushels in the week ending December 26.
The second lowest weekly total for wheat since 1982 was in the same period in December 1986, when wheat export inspections rang in at 7.022 million bushels, USDA said.
The department said it did not have older data on export inspections readily available.
